confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Tel Aviv price levels; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were inspected. Dining and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is volatile in July and sensitive to security and airspace conditions after the knowledge cutoff. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local price relationship to beer (about 1.4 and 1.2 times the beer anchor) because direct knowledge is weaker. Midrange meal excludes tip. FX value came from search snippets, not a direct page read, and the 16 October figure is also reported by a third-party site; re-verify against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Middle East, adjusted upward for Tel Aviv's high dining and drinks prices. Accommodation is set to July coastal demand, roughly in line with high-season Mediterranean resort cities such as Barcelona or Lisbon.
